PC: Hyperventilation-Initially with a face-mask, and then continued throughout the scenario. Participants should ventilate to at least maintain normocarbia.
Place the patient in Reverse Trendelenburg position
Administer and wait for muscle relaxant to have an effect
Perform direct laryngoscopy and endotracheal intubation-Performed when blood pressure has been properly controlled
SBP: Call for help-The patient's neurosurgeon should be notified, and experienced anesthesia providers gathered to treat this patient
